name: Liberty (South Carolina, United States)
description: Dark blue field with a white crescent in the upper hoist and the name LIBERTY in white along the bottom, after the Moultrie Liberty flag.
history: Liberty is a city in Pickens County, South Carolina. The flag was adopted on 11 August 2008 (agreed by the Liberty council on 11 August 2008 after months of exploring designs, according to Flags of the World citing The Pickens Sentinel; the design is based on the Moultrie flag).
